name: Activation success rate
definition_or_measurement: Activated conversations divided by activation attempts

name: Conversation completion rate
definition_or_measurement: Conversations with a delivered message in each direction divided by activated conversations with two connected parties
privacy_notes: Pseudonymous session and message linkage only

name: One-sided conversations
definition_or_measurement: Conversations with delivered messages in one direction only divided by activated conversations
privacy_notes: Pseudonymous session and message linkage only

name: Messages per conversation
definition_or_measurement: Distribution of message_count for ended conversations

name: Active conversation duration
definition_or_measurement: p50 and p95 of active_duration_ms

name: Early abandonment rate
definition_or_measurement: Abandoned conversations with no delivered message divided by activated conversations

name: Return rate
definition_or_measurement: Actors or tenants with another activation within 7 or 30 days
privacy_notes: Only where a permitted rotating pseudonym exists

name: End-to-end delivery latency
definition_or_measurement: delivery_acknowledged_at_utc minus accepted_at_utc; count p50 p95 p99 and maximum
privacy_notes: Use gateway server time and no content

name: Pipeline latency
definition_or_measurement: ASR completion or text acceptance to translation or TTS completion; count p50 p95 p99 and maximum

name: Delivery success rate
definition_or_measurement: delivered divided by delivered plus failed plus expired

name: Delivery SLO breach rate
definition_or_measurement: Delivered messages exceeding the documented delivery latency SLO divided by delivered messages
privacy_notes: Separate SLOs for text and audio

name: Partial-processing rate
definition_or_measurement: terminal_outcome=partial divided by all terminal outcomes

name: Duplicate delivery rate
definition_or_measurement: Messages with more than one recipient acknowledgement divided by messages with at least one acknowledgement

name: Ordering error rate
definition_or_measurement: Conversation-direction pairs whose recipient order differs from sender sequence divided by conversations with at least two deliveries

name: Fallback success rate
definition_or_measurement: Messages delivered via polling divided by messages switched to polling

name: ASR success rate
definition_or_measurement: Successful ASR jobs divided by started ASR jobs

name: ASR latency
definition_or_measurement: Count p50 p95 p99 and maximum of ASR duration_ms

name: ASR real-time factor
definition_or_measurement: ASR duration_ms divided by recording_duration_ms

name: ASR user correction rate
definition_or_measurement: Audio messages explicitly corrected before sending divided by audio messages with an ASR result
privacy_notes: Store correction flag not text unless consented

name: ASR re-record or repeat rate
definition_or_measurement: New recording within 60 seconds of an unsent ASR result divided by ASR results

name: ASR empty-result rate
definition_or_measurement: Successful ASR results empty or whitespace-only divided by successful ASR results

name: Negative ASR feedback rate
definition_or_measurement: ASR ratings 1–2 or transcription_incorrect feedback divided by submitted ASR ratings

name: ASR reference error rate
definition_or_measurement: WER and CER on a separate consented annotated evaluation corpus

name: Translation success rate
definition_or_measurement: Successful translations divided by started translations

name: Translation latency
definition_or_measurement: Count p50 p95 p99 and maximum of translation duration_ms

name: Negative translation rating
definition_or_measurement: Ratings 1–2 or translation_incorrect feedback divided by submitted translation ratings

name: Translation understandability rating
definition_or_measurement: Share of ratings 4–5 and mean; display response rate

name: Resend after translation
definition_or_measurement: Edited messages or same-direction follow-up within 60 seconds divided by translations
privacy_notes: Do not store text unless consented

name: Language-direction error
definition_or_measurement: Results reported with wrong source or target language divided by translations

name: Safety-critical translation feedback
definition_or_measurement: Count and rate of meaning_changed offensive or sensitive_context feedback

name: Translation reference quality
definition_or_measurement: COMET or BLEU plus human MQM on a separate approved gold corpus

name: TTS success rate
definition_or_measurement: Successful TTS jobs divided by started TTS jobs

name: TTS latency
definition_or_measurement: Count p50 p95 p99 and maximum of TTS duration_ms

name: Playback-start success rate
definition_or_measurement: Playback started divided by messages with available TTS audio

name: Playback completion rate
definition_or_measurement: Playback completed divided by playback started

name: Playback early-stop rate
definition_or_measurement: Playbacks stopped before 80 percent of output duration divided by started playbacks
privacy_notes: Do not interpret as failure without feedback

name: Playback replay rate
definition_or_measurement: Messages with at least two playback starts divided by messages with at least one playback start

name: Negative audio feedback rate
definition_or_measurement: Negative TTS or audio ratings divided by submitted audio ratings

name: Microphone-permission success rate
definition_or_measurement: Permission granted divided by permission requested

name: Recording success rate
definition_or_measurement: recording_finished divided by recording_started

name: Conversion success rate
definition_or_measurement: Successful conversions divided by started conversions

name: Upload success rate
definition_or_measurement: message_upload_completed divided by upload attempts

name: Upload latency
definition_or_measurement: Count p50 p95 p99 and maximum of upload_duration_ms

name: Upload throughput
definition_or_measurement: input_bytes divided by upload_duration_ms times 1000

name: User cancellation during processing
definition_or_measurement: Messages cancelled before a terminal pipeline result divided by started processing jobs
privacy_notes: Separate user action from technical failure

name: Browser compatibility error rate
definition_or_measurement: client_media plus client_conversion failures divided by recording attempts

name: ASR reference error
definition_or_measurement: WER or CER with confidence intervals on a frozen representative gold corpus

name: ASR production proxy
definition_or_measurement: A4–A7 by model comparison unit

name: Translation reference quality
definition_or_measurement: COMET and human MQM using the same corpus and rubric

name: Meaning-loss rate
definition_or_measurement: meaning_changed feedback divided by translations with feedback

name: TTS listening quality
definition_or_measurement: Mean and 4–5 share of controlled voluntary intelligibility and naturalness test

name: Model stage success rate
definition_or_measurement: Successful stage calls divided by started stage calls

name: Model latency and real-time factor
definition_or_measurement: Count p50 p95 p99 and maximum by model language and length bucket

name: Model end-to-end benefit
definition_or_measurement: Q1 Q3 F2 F7 and F8 for comparable model arms

name: Model resource and cost efficiency
definition_or_measurement: CPU RAM queue time and reliable cost per successful translation

name: Model regression rate
definition_or_measurement: Metrics outside defined baseline tolerance after model or configuration change

name: Connection success rate
definition_or_measurement: Successfully opened WebSockets divided by connection attempts

name: Unexpected disconnect rate
definition_or_measurement: Disconnects whose reason is not normal_end divided by active connections

name: Reconnect success rate
definition_or_measurement: Reconnects completed within 60 seconds divided by reconnect attempts

name: Heartbeat timeout rate
definition_or_measurement: Heartbeat timeouts divided by connection minutes

name: Fallback rate
definition_or_measurement: Messages or conversations with fallback_used=true divided by total messages or conversations
privacy_notes: Report message and conversation levels separately

name: Service failure rate
definition_or_measurement: Stage failures divided by started jobs for that stage

name: Timeout rate
definition_or_measurement: Timeout failures divided by started jobs

name: Retry rate
definition_or_measurement: Jobs with retry_count greater than zero divided by started jobs plus retry-count distribution

name: Capacity indicator
definition_or_measurement: Queue wait queue depth and saturation per service
privacy_notes: No session IDs in metric labels

name: SLO compliance
definition_or_measurement: Valid measurements meeting documented KPI SLO divided by valid measurements in SLO window

name: Feedback response rate
definition_or_measurement: Sessions or messages with feedback divided by feedback invitations

name: Perceived understandability
definition_or_measurement: 4–5 share and mean of SQ1

name: Perceived usability
definition_or_measurement: 4–5 share and mean of SQ3

name: Problem rate
definition_or_measurement: Feedback with issue category divided by submitted feedback

name: Support-contact rate
definition_or_measurement: Conversations linked to an authorised support case divided by ended conversations

name: Support-case reproducibility
definition_or_measurement: Support cases with sufficient correlated telemetry divided by support cases

name: Perceived speed
definition_or_measurement: 4–5 share and mean of SQ2

name: Trust in SSF
definition_or_measurement: 4–5 share and mean of SQ4 where SQ4 was shown

name: Inter-turn time

name: Return after interruption

name: Follow-up contact

name: Time to decision

name: Understood or not-understood signal

name: Explicit clarification questions
